A curling iron is a kitchen appliance for styling hair. It is a straightener consisting of a metal rod with a hollow barrel to coil, curl, or straighten hair with hot metal segments inside. The hot iron is pressed through the hair to change the curl, shape, length or thickness, or to remove a curl. It is commonly used in professional salons.Curling irons have been around for decades, but they have experienced significant improvements in recent years.
An ionic hair curler uses a hair-glowing, hotplate to create curls. This curler is also called a hot rod. Ionic curling irons are the modern equivalent to the hot comb. It is also a modern form of curling. This curler works by using ions to loosen the moisture in the hair, while the heat melts it. The warmed hair takes shape and is held into a curling shape. Ionic curling irons use metal tines, heated by electricity, to curl individual strands of hair, without touching them directly. A non-metallic rod heats the hair by conduction.Curling irons in the USA were first introduced in the 1890s. Until the 1930s, the barrel shape was either conical or rectangular.
